current.text: He is on a two-way contract with Indiana.
He is not in the projected Indiana rotation. The projected bench is Oubre as sixth man, then Toppin, Huff, McConnell and Jarace Walker.
He averaged about 18 points, 6 rebounds, 3 assists and 3 blocks in Summer League.
Experts think he is a real rotation wing who is too good for a two-way deal and could play 20 minutes a night.
One expert rates him above Jarace Walker and would not be shocked if he became better than Kelly Oubre Jr. this season.

durable.text: Experts call him one of the best perimeter defenders and shot blockers in a long time, possibly the best shot blocking guard or wing in the NBA.
His offense is a work in progress.

note: He is not a draft target. Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 437), ESPN has no price, and the Yahoo projection of 9 games is only a two-way placeholder. The upside is defensive stats: in 13 games last season he averaged 1.5 steals and 1.1 blocks in 23.9 minutes, and he blocked 3 shots per game in Summer League. Early in the season, check whether Carlisle gives him real wing minutes ahead of Oubre or Walker, or whether he gets a standard contract. If he gets about 20 minutes a night, pick him up on waivers for steals and blocks.
